title: Qatraneh Roadside Magnetic Transect Inference-Stability Reproducibility Package
description: Machine-readable Qatraneh roadside magnetic-susceptibility data, derived result tables, deterministic Python code, and explicitly labeled figure-derived Di Martino et al. (2026) approximate values supporting a descriptive consistency check for the manuscript Roadside Magnetic Transects Can Appear Complete Before Spatial Inference Stabilizes. The third-party Daejeon publisher XLSX is not redistributed. Author-approved split licensing: software/code under MIT; data, documentation, and author-generated figures under CC BY 4.0. See the included license files for scope.
